Test Scenario / Objective: Full OTA Update with stable Wi-Fi connection (Happy Path)
Preconditions: Scanner is online, battery >= 30%, connected to Wi-Fi 'Airlab', Server is running on port 3030.
Test Steps / Actions:
1. Open Web UI http://<server-ip>:3030
2. Navigate to OTA tab
3. Upload 'firmware_ota_update.bin' targeting 'all'
4. Observe device LCD screen and server console
Expected Result: Device receives MQTT trigger on 'config/ota', displays OTA screen with progress 0% -> 100%, server logs HTTP GET /firmware.bin (Status 200), device verifies sha256/magic, switches boot partition, and reboots smoothly.

Test Scenario / Objective: Targeted OTA Trigger by Specific Device ID
Preconditions: Multiple scanners online (or default 'scanpro-test-01'). Server running.
Test Steps / Actions:
1. In Web UI OTA section, specify target device 'scanpro-test-01'
2. Click Upload & Deploy
3. Check server MQTT topic and device responses
Expected Result: Server publishes to 'device/scanpro-test-01/ota'. Only the specified target scanner begins OTA update; untargeted devices ignore the command.

Test Scenario / Objective: Single Wi-Fi Disconnect mid-transfer at ~50% and Auto-Resume
Preconditions: Scanner running resilient firmware. OTA update initiated.
Test Steps / Actions:
1. Initiate OTA update from Dashboard
2. At ~50% progress, disable Wi-Fi AP or turn off router
3. Observe LCD screen status for 10-20 seconds
4. Re-enable Wi-Fi AP and observe reconnection
Expected Result: Screen immediately updates to 'Wi-Fi Lost (50%) / Waiting to reconnect...'. When Wi-Fi reconnects, screen shows 'Wi-Fi Recovered! / Resuming download...', device issues HTTP Range: bytes=X-, downloads remainder from 50% to 100%, and reboots.

Preconditions: OTA in progress, reaching final sector transfer.
Test Steps / Actions:
1. Trigger OTA
2. Disconnect Wi-Fi when progress bar reaches 75% - 80%
3. Wait 15 seconds
4. Reconnect Wi-Fi
Expected Result: Device catches disconnect within 4s timeout, pauses at 75%-80%, reconnects, sends 'Range: bytes=<75% offset>-', downloads last 20-25%, successfully passes esp_ota_end verification, reboots into new partition.

Preconditions: OTA in progress at the beginning of transfer.
Test Steps / Actions:
1. Trigger OTA
2. Disconnect Wi-Fi almost immediately after start (10-15%)
3. Reconnect Wi-Fi after 10 seconds
Expected Result: Device freezes progress at 10-15%, shows 'Wi-Fi Lost (15%)', reconnects, sends Range header from the partial offset, resumes smoothly without restarting from 0% if server honors Range.

Test Steps / Actions:
1. Trigger OTA
2. Disconnect Wi-Fi at 25% -> Wait 10s -> Reconnect (resumes to 30%)
3. Disconnect Wi-Fi again at 65% -> Wait 10s -> Reconnect
4. Let download complete to 100%
Expected Result: Device handles each disconnect cleanly: pauses, displays Wi-Fi lost status, resumes with updated Range offsets each time, completes download, verifies binary integrity, and boots properly.

Test Scenario / Objective: Transient network glitch / Weak RSSI drop (< 3 seconds)
Test Steps / Actions:
1. During OTA at ~40%, move scanner to fringe coverage or trigger brief Wi-Fi toggle (< 3s)
2. Restore signal immediately
Expected Result: Read loop detects connection drop within 4s timeout, re-establishes HTTP connection using Range header without rebooting or crashing, and continues progress.

Test Scenario / Objective: Extended Wi-Fi Outage exceeding maximum retries (> 3-5 mins)
Preconditions: OTA in progress, Wi-Fi AP is permanently powered down.
Test Steps / Actions:
1. Trigger OTA
2. Disconnect Wi-Fi at 40%
3. Leave Wi-Fi off for > 5 minutes (exceeding MAX_RETRIES=180)
Expected Result: Device safely aborts OTA handle via esp_ota_abort(), displays 'Update Aborted! / Network Timeout' on screen, keeps existing boot partition untouched, and allows device to resume normal operation upon reboot.

Test Scenario / Objective: Server rejects Range header (Responds HTTP 200 instead of 206)
Preconditions: Server modified to ignore Range header or non-supporting proxy.
Test Steps / Actions:
1. Trigger OTA with simulated 200 OK on resume
2. Drop Wi-Fi at 50% and reconnect
Expected Result: Device detects status_code == 200, logs warning 'Server did not honor Range', cleanly aborts ota_handle, calls esp_ota_begin to re-erase, resets progress to 0%, and downloads full image cleanly.

Test Scenario / Objective: Three (3) Consecutive Resume Failures fallback to clean restart
Preconditions: Corrupted chunk or repeated TCP reset on Range requests.
Test Steps / Actions: 1. Trigger OTA and force repeated Range request failures (>= 3 times)
Expected Result: Device triggers safety fallback: aborts ota_handle, resets total_bytes_written = 0, displays 'Restarting Download from 0%...', and restarts download cleanly from byte 0.

Test Scenario / Objective: Power Loss / Battery Removal during OTA transfer
Preconditions: Scanner updating firmware at any percentage.
Test Steps / Actions:
1. During active OTA download at 50%, turn off power switch or unplug battery
2. Wait 5 seconds
3. Power device back on
Expected Result: Device reboots safely into existing valid app partition (ota_0). otadata remains pointing to current valid firmware. Device does NOT get bricked.

Preconditions: User uploads an invalid non-ESP32 binary or truncated file.
Test Steps / Actions:
1. Upload a text file or truncated bin file via Web UI OTA form
2. Device receives trigger and begins download
Expected Result: Device detects invalid magic byte (expected 0xE9) or esp_ota_end verification fails with ESP_ERR_OTA_VALIDATE_FAILED. Device displays 'Update Failed! / Image Corrupted', aborts write, and keeps current firmware.

Test Scenario / Objective: LCD Display & Animations during active OTA download
Test Steps / Actions:
1. Trigger OTA
2. Observe LCD display throughout the process
Expected Result: Screen loads 'scr_ota' with dark background, animated spinner rotating smoothly, percentage label matching progress bar (0% to 100%), and cyan bar filling continuously.

Test Steps / Actions:
1. Disconnect Wi-Fi at 60%
2. Observe screen text
Expected Result:
Text changes from 'Downloading Update...' to 'Wi-Fi Lost (60%)
Waiting to reconnect...'. Spinner continues or pauses without crash.

Test Scenario / Objective: LCD Display on Wi-Fi Recovery & Finalizing
Test Steps / Actions:
1. Reconnect Wi-Fi
2. Observe transition to 100% and reboot
Expected Result:
Text updates to 'Wi-Fi Recovered!
Resuming download...', resumes to 100%, changes to 'Verifying Image
& Writing Boot...', then 'Update Complete!
Rebooting now...' before soft restart.

Test Scenario / Objective: Server-Side HTTP Request and Range Logging
Test Steps / Actions:
1. Monitor server console (task logs)
2. Perform normal OTA and resumed OTA
Expected Result:
Initial request logs: '[OTA HTTP] Incoming GET /firmware.bin | Range: None'
Resumed request logs: '[OTA HTTP] Incoming GET /firmware.bin | Range: bytes=XXXXXX-'
Confirming server handles RFC 7233 HTTP 206 Partial Content.

Preconditions: Device completes OTA update and reboots.
Test Steps / Actions:
1. Observe device serial log and MQTT dashboard after reboot
2. Check status topic 'device/<id>/status'
Expected Result: Device boots from newly updated partition (ota_1 or ota_0), initializes peripherals (Display, Audio, GM65, BLE, Wi-Fi), publishes online status to server with updated timestamp and credentials intact.
